def raw_roles(proposed, qualified, native, mode, domain, index, data):
    error = native['error']
    need(type(error) is str, 'whole original error wire string')
    if error == '':
        need(proposed['raw'] is None and proposed['semantic'] is None
             and qualified['raw'] is None and qualified['semantic'] is None,
             'empty own operation cannot borrow nonempty raw or coordinate roles')
        return
    raw, semantic = proposed['raw'], proposed['semantic']
    expected_raw, expected_semantic = qualified['raw'], qualified['semantic']
    need(type(raw) is dict and set(raw) == set(expected_raw) and type(raw['body']) is str
         and type(raw['segments']) is list
         and all(type(segment) is dict and type(segment.get('raw')) is str for segment in raw['segments']),
         'closed complete original raw association shape')
    need(raw['body'] == error and same(raw['body_identity'], pin(error.encode()))
         and same(raw['context'], context(native))
         and ''.join(segment['raw'] for segment in raw['segments']) == error,
         'whole lossless own raw body context and physical segments')
    need(same(raw, expected_raw), 'whole own raw wire and opaque address lexemes')
    need(type(semantic) is dict and set(semantic) == set(expected_semantic)
         and type(semantic['first_cause']) is dict
         and type(semantic['first_cause'].get('index')) is int
         and same(semantic['record'], [mode, domain, index])
         and semantic['first_cause'].get('domain') == domain
         and semantic['first_cause']['index'] == index
         and same(semantic['first_cause'].get('primary'), qualified['primary'])
         and same(semantic['context'], context(native)), 'own source-first nonempty cause and context')
    need(same(semantic['first_cause'], expected_semantic['first_cause'])
         and same(semantic['phases'], expected_semantic['phases']),
         'whole qualified ordered source phase class and coordinate roles')
    need(same(semantic['stack'], expected_semantic['stack'])
         and same(semantic['stack']['body'], pin(error.encode())), 'whole qualified stack and physical coordinates')
    need(same(semantic['opaque'], expected_semantic['opaque'])
         and same(semantic['observer'], expected_semantic['observer']),
         'whole own qualified address allocation opaque and observer roles')
    forwarding = semantic['forwarding']
    if expected_semantic['forwarding'] is None:
        need(forwarding is None, 'absent nested association cannot borrow forwarding')
    else:
        need(type(forwarding) is dict and set(forwarding) == set(expected_semantic['forwarding']),
             'closed complete nested association')
        inner = forwarding['inner_record']
        need(type(inner) is list and len(inner) == 3 and inner[0] == mode and inner[1] == 'api'
             and type(inner[2]) is int and 0 <= inner[2] < len(data[mode]['api']),
             'own mode and source API nested operand allocation')
        body = data[mode]['api'][inner[2]]['error']
        need(same(forwarding['outer_record'], [mode, domain, index])
             and forwarding['whole_inner_body'] == body
             and same(forwarding['source_relation']['inner_body'], pin(body.encode()))
             and forwarding['whole_outer_prefix'] + forwarding['whole_new_outer_trace'] == error
             and same(forwarding, expected_semantic['forwarding']),
             'whole own nested source operand prefix and new outer trace')
    need(same(semantic, expected_semantic), 'complete own raw coordinate address and nested semantic association')


def operation_link(proposed, qualified, native, ctx, helper, parser, mode, domain, index, data):
    need(type(proposed) is dict and set(proposed) == OP_KEYS
         and type(proposed['record']) is list and len(proposed['record']) == 3
         and type(proposed['record'][2]) is int and same(proposed['record'], [mode, domain, index]),

         'whole own native operation and qualified cause source custody')
    need(same(proposed['source'], qualified['source']) and same(proposed['context'], context(native)),
         'whole own operation source arguments kind and caller association')
    need(native.get('helper') == helper
         and same(proposed['helper_context'], None if helper is None else pin(canonical(ctx['source_helpers'][helper]))),
         'whole independently inverted source helper operation ownership')
    if parser is not None:
        need(type(parser) is int and 0 <= parser < len(ctx['parsers']), 'qualified own parser allocation range')
    need(same(proposed['parser_context'], None if parser is None else pin(canonical(ctx['parsers'][parser]))),

        need(source['helper'] == helper and source['parse'] == parser
             and native['parse'] == parser and same(source['caller'], native['caller'])
             and source['kind'] == native['kind'] and type(source['index']) is int and source['index'] == index,
             'complete independently inverted API source caller helper and parser relationships')
    elif domain == 'parses':
        need(same(qualified['source'], ctx['parsers'][index])
             and legacy(native['before']) == ctx['parsers'][index]['whole_before'],
             'whole own parser source input filename and before-graph relationship')
    else:
        need(qualified['source'] is None, 'private and test-run observations do not acquire source first-cause authority')
    api = native['api'] if domain == 'copies' else None
    if api is not None:
        need(type(api) is int and 0 <= api < len(data[mode]['api']), 'qualified own private-copy API allocation range')
    need(same(proposed['api_record'], None if api is None else [mode, 'api', api]),
         'whole own private-copy recorded API relationship')
    authority = 'source_first_cause' if domain in ('api', 'parses') else 'qualified_prior_observation'
    field_name = 'completed' if domain == 'test_run' else 'accepted'
    expected_status = dict(field=field_name, value=native[field_name], authority=authority)

def origin_relation(data, mode, row, ctx):
    """Select source origin families independently of producer traversal."""
    value, source = row['meaning'], row['source_contract']
    helper = source['context']['helper']
    causes = cause_mode(data, mode)
    if helper is not None:
        model = ctx['source_helpers'][helper]
        failed_api = [index for index in model['api_members'] if causes['domains']['api']['records'][index]['primary'] is not None]
        failed_parse = [index for index in model['parse_members'] if causes['domains']['parses']['records'][index]['primary'] is not None]
        need(bool(failed_api) != bool(failed_parse), 'source helper has exactly one intended failing operation family')
        domain, index = ('api', min(failed_api)) if failed_api else ('parses', min(failed_parse))
        cause = causes['domains'][domain]['records'][index]
        first_source = cause['source'] if domain == 'api' else dict(context=ctx['parsers'][index], primary=cause['primary'])
        need(value['first_record'] == [mode, domain, index] and same(value['first_source'], first_source)
             and same(value['source_helper'], model) and value['primary'] == cause['primary'],
             'whole independently selected source helper first failure and consumer meaning')
        return dict(kind='source-helper-first-failure', helper=helper, first_record=[mode, domain, index],
                    first_source=first_source, cause=pin(canonical(cause)), primary=cause['primary'], source_helper=model)
    origin = value['origin']
    kind = origin['kind']
    if kind == 'whole-authored-type-width':
        name = origin['name']
        need(name in data['authored']['types'] and same(origin['source_type'], data['authored']['types'][name]),
             'whole independently admitted authored type and width source origin')
        return dict(kind=kind, model=origin, name=name, authored_type=pin(canonical(data['authored']['types'][name])))
    if kind == 'synthetic-authored-first-line-and-opaque-original-trace':
        trace = data[mode]['consumers'][3]['actual']
        need(type(trace) is str and origin['whole_native_trace'] == pin(trace.encode())
             and trace.startswith(origin['message'] + '\n'), 'complete own opaque synthetic trace and authored first line')
        return dict(kind=kind, model=origin, opaque_trace=trace, source_scope=pin(canonical(source['source_scope'])))
    if kind == 'whole-authored-actor-detached-copy':
        actor, witness_index = origin['actor'], origin['qualified_test_copy']['index']
        need(type(actor) is int and actor == 0 and same(origin['source_actor'], data['actors']['actors']['local'])
             and ctx['parsers'][actor]['source_input'] == pin(data['actors']['sources']['local'].encode()),
             'whole authored actor and own parser source input origin')
        witnesses = [item for item in data['copy_inputs']['rows'] if item['index'] == witness_index]
        proofs = [item for item in data['copy_proofs']['proofs']
                  if item['mode'] == mode and item['kind'] == 'returned' and item['original_index'] == witness_index]
        need(type(witness_index) is int and 0 <= witness_index < len(data[mode]['copies'])
             and len(witnesses) == len(proofs) == 1, 'unique complete own actor-copy witness and provider allocation')
        witness, proof = witnesses[0], proofs[0]
        provider = 'storable' if mode == 'storable' else 'ordinary'
        need(origin['qualified_test_copy']['witness'] == pin(canonical(witness))
             and origin['qualified_test_copy']['provider'] == proof['provider'] == provider
             and same(witness['native']['before'], data[mode]['copies'][witness_index]['before']),
             'whole qualified actor-copy input primitive kinds and dated provider witness')
        return dict(kind=kind, model=origin, actor=actor, parser_record=[mode, 'parses', actor],
            copy_record=[mode, 'copies', witness_index], source_actor=pin(canonical(data['actors']['actors']['local'])),
            copy_input=pin(canonical(witness)), provider_proof=pin(canonical(proof)))
    need(kind in ('readonly-authored-json', 'qualified-own-source-api'), 'complete source-derived consumer origin family')
    api = origin['api']
    need(type(api) is int and 0 <= api < len(data[mode]['api']), 'own source-derived consumer API origin allocation')
    product = data['products']['apis'][api]
    need(type(product['source_index']) is int and product['source_index'] == api
         and origin['whole_source_product'] == pin(canonical(product)), 'whole own consumer source API product association')
    return dict(kind=kind, model=origin, record=[mode, 'api', api],
        cause=pin(canonical(causes['domains']['api']['records'][api])), source_product=pin(canonical(product)))

         and [mode['mode'] for mode in candidate['modes']] == list(MODES), 'complete ordered original association modes')
    proposed_modes = {mode['mode']: mode for mode in candidate['modes']}

            consumed.add((mode, 'parser', index))
        for domain in ('parses', 'api', 'copies', 'test_run'):
            for index, original in enumerate(records(native, domain)):

                 'role', 'operand', 'outcome', 'truth_authority', 'origin'} and type(link['index']) is int and link['index'] == index,
                 'closed typed ordered source consumer association')
            need(source['helper'] == consumer_helpers.get(index) and same(link['source_context'], source)
                 and same(qualified['source_contract']['context'], source)
                 and same(value['source_assertion'], qualified['source_contract'])
                 and same(link['source_contract'], pin(canonical(qualified['source_contract']))),
                 'whole own consumer source assertion helper and caller context')
            need(same(link['native'], pin(canonical(original))) and same(qualified['native'], original)
                 and same(link['meaning'], pin(canonical(value))), 'whole own consumer native body and qualified source meaning')
            role = 'remaining' if source['helper'] is None else 'helper'

                 and same(link['operand'], value['operand'])

            need(same(link['origin'], origin_relation(data, mode, qualified, ctx)),

            consumed.add((mode, 'consumer', index))
            bindings.append(dict(record=[mode, 'consumer', index], relation=pin(canonical(link)), source=link['source_contract'],
                                 native=link['native'], operand=pin(canonical(link['operand'])), outcome=link['outcome']))
    expected = {(mode, domain, index) for mode in MODES for domain in DOMAINS
                for index in range(len(records(data[mode], domain)))}
    expected |= {(mode, role, index) for mode in MODES for role, count in
                 (('helper', len(context_mode(data, mode)['source_helpers'])),
                  ('parser', len(context_mode(data, mode)['parsers'])),
                  ('consumer', len(context_mode(data, mode)['source_consumers']))) for index in range(count)}
    need(consumed == expected, 'every complete original association consumed exactly once')

SUCCESS = 'PASS complete independent original context/cause/coordinate/consumer association; canonical/parent acceptance and higher owners remain separate.\n'
EXCLUDED = {'proof.json', 'manifest.json'} | {label + suffix
    for label in ('seal', 'default', 'staged-doctrines') for suffix in ('-started.json', '-actual.json')}


def read(name):
    return json.loads((BASE / name).read_bytes())


def bodies(row):
    for name, entry in row.items():
        raw = entry['body'].encode() if 'body' in entry else bytes.fromhex(entry['body_hex'])
        need(pin(raw) == entry['identity'], 'whole native programme/input body identity')
        yield name, raw


def gate(label, command, current=False, development=False, status=0):
    actual, started = read(label + '-actual.json'), read(label + '-started.json')
    extra = {'candidate_inputs'} if 'candidate_inputs' in started else set()
    need(set(started) == {'command', 'programmes', 'expected_status', 'stdout_path', 'stderr_path', 'condition'} | extra
         and set(actual) == set(started) | {'status', 'stdout', 'stderr', 'programmes_after'}
             | ({'candidate_inputs_after'} if extra else set())
         and all(same(actual[key], value) for key, value in started.items()), 'closed complete native gate')
    need(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == status
         and type(actual['expected_status']) is int and actual['expected_status'] == status
         and actual['command'] == ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *command]
         and same(actual['programmes'], actual['programmes_after']), 'typed native declared/observed outcome and conserved source epoch')
    if extra:
        need(same(actual['candidate_inputs'], actual['candidate_inputs_after']), 'whole native candidate input conservation')
        for name, identity in actual['candidate_inputs'].items():
            path = Path(name)
            need(path.parent == BASE and path.suffix == '.gz' and not path.is_symlink()
                 and pin(path.read_bytes()) == identity, 'whole saved native candidate body')
    own = {name: entry for name, entry in actual['programmes'].items() if Path(name).parent == BASE and Path(name).suffix == '.py'}
    if development:
        epoch = read('development-epochs.json')['epochs'][label]
        need(same(own, epoch['programmes']) and pin((BASE / (label + '-actual.json')).read_bytes()) == epoch['actual'],
             'complete dated development source/native epoch')
    else:
        need(same(own, read('formal-programmes.json')['programmes']), 'whole frozen formal programme membership and bodies')
    for name, raw in bodies(actual['programmes']):
        if current and not development:
            need(Path(name).read_bytes() == raw, 'whole current native programme/input body')
    stream = Path('.artifacts') / BASE.name / 'checks' / label
    need(actual['stdout_path'] == str(stream / 'stdout.txt') and actual['stderr_path'] == str(stream / 'stderr.txt')
         and re.match(r'ram-guard: PID [0-9]+; host [0-9]+\.[0-9]+%; host cutoff 88%; descendant RSS cutoff 4096 MiB; poll 2s\n', actual['stderr'])
         and 'ram-guard: terminating PID tree' not in actual['stderr'], 'unchanged guard and repository-local full terminal routes')
    return pin(canonical(actual))

             for name, body in sources.items()), 'whole ordinary same-volume fixed admission namespace')
    module_names = {Path(name).stem for name in names if name.endswith('.py')} | {'capture'}
    prior = {name: sys.modules[name] for name in module_names if name in sys.modules}

import re

from capture import BASE, pin, save

TASK = 'docs/tasks/SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER.md'
BOOK = 'docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md'
REGISTRY = 'doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl'


def need(value, cause):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(cause)


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def same(left, right):
    return canonical(left) == canonical(right)


def nodes(body):
    starts = list(re.finditer(rb'^- ID: `([^`]+)`\n', body, re.M))
    result = {row[1].decode(): body[row.start():starts[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(starts) else len(body)]
              for i, row in enumerate(starts)}
    need(len(result) == len(starts), 'unique complete canonical task graph')
    return result


def field(block, name):
    match = re.search(rb'^  ' + name.encode() + rb': `(.*)`$', block, re.M)
    return match[1].decode() if match else None


def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', '--literal-pathspecs', *args], capture_output=True)
    need(result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'whole read-only fixed canonical Git protocol')
    return result.stdout


def fixed(names):
    names = list(names)
    request = b''.join((PLAN['revision'] + ':' + name + '\n').encode() for name in names)
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'], input=request, capture_output=True)
    need(result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'complete fixed canonical source batch')
    stream, sources = io.BytesIO(result.stdout), {}
    for name in names:
        header = stream.readline().split()
        need(len(header) == 3 and header[1] == b'blob', 'whole declared canonical source header')
        body = stream.read(int(header[2]))
        need(len(body) == int(header[2]) and stream.read(1) == b'\n', 'whole canonical source body and EOF')
        sources[name] = body
    need(stream.read(1) == b'' and len(sources) == len(names), 'complete unique canonical source domain')
    return sources


def canonical_sources():
    names = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', PLAN['revision'], '--', 'docs/knowledge', 'docs/decisions').decode().splitlines()
    return fixed(name for name in names if name.endswith('.md'))


def metrics(sources):
    rows = [dict(bytes=len(body), lines=body.count(b'\n'), width=max(map(len, body.splitlines()), default=0)) for body in sources.values()]
    return dict(files=len(rows), bytes_total=sum(row['bytes'] for row in rows), lines_total=sum(row['lines'] for row in rows),
                bytes_each=max(row['bytes'] for row in rows), lines_each=max(row['lines'] for row in rows),
                line_bytes_each=max(row['width'] for row in rows))


def load_product(name):
    raw = gzip.decompress((BASE / name).read_bytes())
    value = json.loads(raw)
    need(raw == canonical(value), 'whole canonical compressed preparation product')
    return value


def save_product(name, value):
    path = BASE / name
    need(not path.exists(), 'retain first complete canonical preparation product')
    path.write_bytes(gzip.compress(canonical(value), mtime=0))


def public():
    retained = json.loads((BASE / 'integration-contract.json').read_bytes())['retained_dependencies']
    bodies = fixed(retained)
    need(all(pin(body) == retained[name] and Path(name).read_bytes() == body for name, body in bodies.items()),
         'all twelve unchanged maintained source interfaces')
    name = 'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py'
    body = fixed([name])[name]
    need(Path(name).read_bytes() == body, 'whole unchanged current canonical factory')
    result = {'__name__': 'fixed_original_association_current_factory', '__file__': name}
    previous = sys.path[:]
    try:
        sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
        exec(compile(body, name, 'exec'), result)
    finally:
        sys.path[:] = previous
    return result

"""Save each complete native guard terminal outside the guarded process tree."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

BASE = Path('docs/audits/original-context-cause-consumer-association-20261012')


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def save(name, value):
    path = BASE / name
    if path.exists():
        raise ValueError('retain first complete recovery record: ' + name)
    path.write_bytes(canonical(value))


def instruments(command):
    names = {str(BASE / 'capture.py'), 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py',
             't/python/test_record_value_gate_streams.py', 'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py',
             'scripts/record_value_raw_fact.py', 'scripts/record_value_consumer_fact.py', 'scripts/record_value_cause_fact.py', 't/python/test_record_value_current_publication.py'}
    plan = json.loads((BASE / 'plan.json').read_bytes())
    names.update(str(BASE / name) for name in ('plan.json', 'book-review.json', 'guide.txt',
        'integration-contract.json', 'admission-normal-commit.json', 'activation-task.gz',
        'activation-memory.gz', 'activation-index.gz', 'input-contracts.json', 'input-contracts-initial.json',
        'interface-review.json', 'activation-task-initial.gz', 'development-initial-programmes.json',
        'typed-equality-repair.json', 'capture-typed-repair-expansion.json',
        'capture-candidate-input-expansion.json'))
    names.update(str(path) for path in BASE.glob('*.py'))
    for role in ('admission', 'context', 'cause', 'consumer'):
        names.update(str(path) for path in Path(plan[role]).glob('*.py'))
    names.update(arg for arg in command if '\n' not in arg and len(arg) < 240 and Path(arg).is_file())
    result = {}
    for name in sorted(names):
        raw = Path(name).read_bytes()
        try:
            body = dict(body=raw.decode('utf-8'))
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            body = dict(body_hex=raw.hex())
        result[name] = dict(**body, identity=pin(raw))
    return result


def candidate_inputs(command):
    result = {}
    if '--candidate' in command:
        index = command.index('--candidate')
        if index + 1 >= len(command):
            raise ValueError('explicit native candidate input')
        name = command[index + 1]
        path = BASE / name
        if Path(name).name != name or not name.endswith('.json.gz') or path.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError('ordinary own complete native candidate input')
        result[str(path)] = pin(path.read_bytes())
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--expect', type=int, choices=(0, 1), default=0)
    parser.add_argument('label')
    parser.add_argument('command', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.command or not args.label or any(c not in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-' for c in args.label):
        raise ValueError('explicit ordinary recovery gate and command')
    command = ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *args.command]
    epoch = instruments(args.command)
    folder = Path('.artifacts') / BASE.name / 'checks' / args.label
    # The public boundary checker validates the output route without creating it.
    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('recovery', 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py')
    recovery = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(recovery)
    recovery.local(folder)
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    stdout, stderr = folder / 'stdout.txt', folder / 'stderr.txt'
    candidates = candidate_inputs(args.command)
    started = dict(command=command, programmes=epoch, candidate_inputs=candidates, expected_status=args.expect,
        stdout_path=str(stdout), stderr_path=str(stderr),
        condition='Complete native terminal writer outside unchanged guard; an expected refusal is not successful original replay.')
    save(args.label + '-started.json', started)
    with stdout.open('xb', buffering=0) as out, stderr.open('xb', buffering=0) as err:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    actual = dict(**started, status=result.returncode, stdout=stdout.read_text(), stderr=stderr.read_text(),
                  programmes_after=instruments(args.command), candidate_inputs_after=candidate_inputs(args.command))
    save(args.label + '-actual.json', actual)
    print(args.label, 'actual native status', result.returncode, flush=True)
    if type(result.returncode) is not int or result.returncode != args.expect or epoch != actual['programmes_after'] or candidates != actual['candidate_inputs_after']:
        raise SystemExit(1)

    add('storable-primitive-kind', ['modes', 1, 'consumers', type_index, 'operand', 'actual'], 'string', truth)
    add('consumer-false-green', cs + [type_index, 'operand', 'actual'], 'increment', truth)
    add('consumer-source-api', cs + [0, 'origin', 'record', 2], 'increment', origin)
    add('consumer-type-source', cs + [type_index, 'origin', 'authored_type', 'sha256'], 'set', origin, '0' * 64)
    add('consumer-copy-witness', cs + [actor_index, 'origin', 'copy_input', 'sha256'], 'set', origin, '0' * 64)
    add('consumer-copy-provider', cs + [actor_index, 'origin', 'provider_proof', 'sha256'], 'set', origin, '0' * 64)
    add('consumer-synthetic-trace', cs + [synthetic, 'origin', 'opaque_trace'], 'truncate', origin)
    labels = [row['label'] for row in rows]
    need(len(labels) == len(set(labels)), 'unique complete separating control declarations')
    return rows


def mutate(candidate, row):
    action, path = row['action'], row['path']
    if action == 'retain':
        return
    parent, key = get(candidate, path[:-1]), path[-1]
    old = parent[key]
    if action == 'set':
        parent[key] = copy.deepcopy(row['value'])
    elif action == 'pop':
        need(type(old) is list and old, 'genuine nonempty omission target')
        old.pop()
    elif action == 'reverse':
        need(type(old) is list and len(old) > 1, 'genuine ordered separating target')
        old.reverse()
    elif action == 'increment':
        need(type(old) is int, 'typed integer separating target')
        parent[key] = old + 1
    elif action == 'float':
        need(type(old) is int, 'typed integer identity separating target')
        parent[key] = float(old)
    elif action == 'string':
        need(type(old) is int, 'typed integer operand separating target')
        parent[key] = str(old)
    elif action == 'truncate':
        need(type(old) is str and old, 'whole nonempty string separating target')
        parent[key] = old[:-1]
    else:
        raise ValueError('undeclared separating operation')

from association_inputs import *


def operation(data, mode, domain, index):
    native = records(data[mode], domain)[index]
    cause = cause_mode(data, mode)['domains'][domain]['records'][index]
    contexts = context_mode(data, mode)
    helper = native.get('helper')
    parser = index if domain == 'parses' else native.get('parse')
    return dict(record=[mode, domain, index], native=pin(canonical(native)),
        cause=pin(canonical(cause)), source=cause['source'], context=context(native),
        helper_context=None if helper is None else pin(canonical(contexts['source_helpers'][helper])),
        parser_context=None if parser is None else pin(canonical(contexts['parsers'][parser])),
        api_record=[mode, 'api', native['api']] if domain == 'copies' and native['api'] is not None else None,
        primary=cause['primary'], status=cause['status'], product=cause['product'],
        raw=cause['raw'], semantic=cause['semantic'])


def origin(data, mode, row):
    meaning, index = row['meaning'], row['index']
    helper = row['source_contract']['context']['helper']
    qualified = cause_mode(data, mode)
    if helper is not None:
        first = qualified['helpers'][helper]['first_record']
        cause = qualified['domains'][first[1]]['records'][first[2]]
        return dict(kind='source-helper-first-failure', helper=helper, first_record=first,
                    first_source=meaning['first_source'], cause=pin(canonical(cause)),
                    primary=meaning['primary'], source_helper=meaning['source_helper'])
    source = meaning['origin']
    kind = source['kind']
    if kind in ('readonly-authored-json', 'qualified-own-source-api'):
        api = source['api']
        return dict(kind=kind, model=source, record=[mode, 'api', api],
            cause=pin(canonical(qualified['domains']['api']['records'][api])),
            source_product=pin(canonical(data['products']['apis'][api])))
    if kind == 'whole-authored-actor-detached-copy':
        copy_index = source['qualified_test_copy']['index']
        witness = next(value for value in data['copy_inputs']['rows'] if value['index'] == copy_index)
        proof = next(value for value in data['copy_proofs']['proofs']
                     if value['mode'] == mode and value['kind'] == 'returned' and value['original_index'] == copy_index)
        return dict(kind=kind, model=source, actor=source['actor'],
            parser_record=[mode, 'parses', source['actor']], copy_record=[mode, 'copies', copy_index],
            source_actor=pin(canonical(data['actors']['actors']['local'])),
            copy_input=pin(canonical(witness)), provider_proof=pin(canonical(proof)))
    if kind == 'whole-authored-type-width':
        return dict(kind=kind, model=source, name=source['name'],
                    authored_type=pin(canonical(data['authored']['types'][source['name']])))
    need(kind == 'synthetic-authored-first-line-and-opaque-original-trace', 'complete producer consumer origin cases')
    return dict(kind=kind, model=source, opaque_trace=data[mode]['consumers'][3]['actual'],
                source_scope=pin(canonical(row['source_contract']['source_scope'])))


def propose(data):
    modes = []
    for mode in MODES:
        ctx, causes = context_mode(data, mode), cause_mode(data, mode)
        operations = {domain: [operation(data, mode, domain, index)
                              for index in range(len(records(data[mode], domain)))] for domain in DOMAINS}
        helpers = []
        for helper in causes['helpers']:
            source = helper['source']
            helpers.append(dict(index=source['index'], source=source, cause=pin(canonical(helper)),
                first_record=helper['first_record'], primary=helper['primary'],
                operations={domain: [[mode, domain, index] for index in source[key]]
                            for domain, key in (('api', 'api_members'), ('copies', 'copy_members'), ('parses', 'parse_members'))},
                consumers=[[mode, 'consumers', index] for index in source['consumer_members']]))
        parsers = []
        for parser in ctx['parsers']:
            index = parser['index']
            parsers.append(dict(index=index, source=parser,
                operation=pin(canonical(operations['parses'][index])),
                api_operations=[[mode, 'api', index] for index in parser['api_members']]))
        consumers = []
        for row in consumer_mode(data, mode)['consumers']:
            index, value = row['index'], row['meaning']
            consumers.append(dict(index=index, source_context=ctx['source_consumers'][index],
                source_contract=pin(canonical(row['source_contract'])), native=pin(canonical(row['native'])),
                meaning=pin(canonical(value)), role=row['role'], operand=value['operand'], outcome=value['outcome'],
                truth_authority='admitted source-derived typed comparison', origin=origin(data, mode, row)))
        modes.append(dict(mode=mode, operations=operations, helpers=helpers, parsers=parsers, consumers=consumers))
    return dict(header(data), modes=modes)

"""Independently consume every source-first context/cause/consumer relationship."""
import argparse
from association_inputs import *

SUCCESS = 'PASS independent complete original context/cause/coordinate/consumer associations; original native/private limits and higher owners retain.\n'
OP_KEYS = {'record', 'native', 'cause', 'source', 'context', 'helper_context', 'parser_context',
           'api_record', 'primary', 'status', 'product', 'raw', 'semantic'}


def legacy(value):
    return pin(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode())


def memberships(contexts, key, population):
    result = {}
    for index, helper in enumerate(contexts['source_helpers']):
        need(type(helper['index']) is int and helper['index'] == index, 'ordered qualified source helper allocation')
        for member in helper[key]:
            need(type(member) is int and 0 <= member < population and member not in result,
                 'unique complete source-context operation ownership')
            result[member] = index
    return result


def parser_memberships(contexts, population):
    result = {}
    for index, parser in enumerate(contexts['parsers']):
        need(type(parser['index']) is int and parser['index'] == index, 'ordered qualified source parser allocation')
        for member in parser['api_members']:
            need(type(member) is int and 0 <= member < population and member not in result,
                 'unique complete source-parser API ownership')
            result[member] = index
    return result


def raw_roles(proposed, qualified, native, mode, domain, index, data):
    error = native['error']
    need(type(error) is str, 'whole original error wire string')
    if error == '':
        need(proposed['raw'] is None and proposed['semantic'] is None
             and qualified['raw'] is None and qualified['semantic'] is None,
             'empty own operation cannot borrow nonempty raw or coordinate roles')
        return
    raw, semantic = proposed['raw'], proposed['semantic']
    expected_raw, expected_semantic = qualified['raw'], qualified['semantic']
    need(type(raw) is dict and set(raw) == set(expected_raw) and type(raw['body']) is str
         and type(raw['segments']) is list
         and all(type(segment) is dict and type(segment.get('raw')) is str for segment in raw['segments']),
         'closed complete original raw association shape')
    need(raw['body'] == error and same(raw['body_identity'], pin(error.encode()))
         and same(raw['context'], context(native))
         and ''.join(segment['raw'] for segment in raw['segments']) == error,
         'whole lossless own raw body context and physical segments')
    need(same(raw, expected_raw), 'whole own raw wire and opaque address lexemes')
    need(type(semantic) is dict and set(semantic) == set(expected_semantic)
         and type(semantic['first_cause']) is dict
         and type(semantic['first_cause'].get('index')) is int
         and same(semantic['record'], [mode, domain, index])
         and semantic['first_cause'].get('domain') == domain
         and semantic['first_cause']['index'] == index
         and same(semantic['first_cause'].get('primary'), qualified['primary'])
         and same(semantic['context'], context(native)), 'own source-first nonempty cause and context')
    need(same(semantic['first_cause'], expected_semantic['first_cause'])
         and same(semantic['phases'], expected_semantic['phases']),
         'whole qualified ordered source phase class and coordinate roles')
    need(same(semantic['stack'], expected_semantic['stack'])
         and same(semantic['stack']['body'], pin(error.encode())), 'whole qualified stack and physical coordinates')
    need(same(semantic['opaque'], expected_semantic['opaque'])
         and same(semantic['observer'], expected_semantic['observer']),
         'whole own qualified address allocation opaque and observer roles')
    forwarding = semantic['forwarding']
    if expected_semantic['forwarding'] is None:
        need(forwarding is None, 'absent nested association cannot borrow forwarding')
    else:
        need(type(forwarding) is dict and set(forwarding) == set(expected_semantic['forwarding']),
             'closed complete nested association')
        inner = forwarding['inner_record']
        need(type(inner) is list and len(inner) == 3 and inner[0] == mode and inner[1] == 'api'
             and type(inner[2]) is int and 0 <= inner[2] < len(data[mode]['api']),
             'own mode and source API nested operand allocation')
        body = data[mode]['api'][inner[2]]['error']
        need(same(forwarding['outer_record'], [mode, domain, index])
             and forwarding['whole_inner_body'] == body
             and same(forwarding['source_relation']['inner_body'], pin(body.encode()))
             and forwarding['whole_outer_prefix'] + forwarding['whole_new_outer_trace'] == error
             and same(forwarding, expected_semantic['forwarding']),
             'whole own nested source operand prefix and new outer trace')
    need(same(semantic, expected_semantic), 'complete own raw coordinate address and nested semantic association')


def operation_link(proposed, qualified, native, ctx, helper, parser, mode, domain, index, data):
    need(type(proposed) is dict and set(proposed) == OP_KEYS
         and type(proposed['record']) is list and len(proposed['record']) == 3
         and type(proposed['record'][2]) is int and same(proposed['record'], [mode, domain, index]),
         'closed typed own mode domain and ordered operation association')
    need(same(proposed['native'], pin(canonical(native))) and same(proposed['cause'], pin(canonical(qualified))),
         'whole own native operation and qualified cause source custody')
    need(same(proposed['source'], qualified['source']) and same(proposed['context'], context(native)),
         'whole own operation source arguments kind and caller association')
    need(native.get('helper') == helper
         and same(proposed['helper_context'], None if helper is None else pin(canonical(ctx['source_helpers'][helper]))),
         'whole independently inverted source helper operation ownership')
    if parser is not None:
        need(type(parser) is int and 0 <= parser < len(ctx['parsers']), 'qualified own parser allocation range')
    need(same(proposed['parser_context'], None if parser is None else pin(canonical(ctx['parsers'][parser]))),
         'whole own parser operation source context association')
    if domain == 'api':
        source = qualified['source']
        need(source['helper'] == helper and source['parse'] == parser
             and native['parse'] == parser and same(source['caller'], native['caller'])
             and source['kind'] == native['kind'] and type(source['index']) is int and source['index'] == index,
             'complete independently inverted API source caller helper and parser relationships')
    elif domain == 'parses':
        need(same(qualified['source'], ctx['parsers'][index])
             and legacy(native['before']) == ctx['parsers'][index]['whole_before'],
             'whole own parser source input filename and before-graph relationship')
    else:
        need(qualified['source'] is None, 'private and test-run observations do not acquire source first-cause authority')
    api = native['api'] if domain == 'copies' else None
    if api is not None:
        need(type(api) is int and 0 <= api < len(data[mode]['api']), 'qualified own private-copy API allocation range')
    need(same(proposed['api_record'], None if api is None else [mode, 'api', api]),
         'whole own private-copy recorded API relationship')
    authority = 'source_first_cause' if domain in ('api', 'parses') else 'qualified_prior_observation'
    field_name = 'completed' if domain == 'test_run' else 'accepted'
    expected_status = dict(field=field_name, value=native[field_name], authority=authority)
    need(type(native[field_name]) is int and same(proposed['status'], expected_status)
         and same(proposed['primary'], qualified['primary'])
         and same(proposed['product'], pin(canonical(native.get('result')))),
         'whole typed source-first or explicitly observational acceptance and product roles')
    if authority == 'source_first_cause':
        need(native[field_name] == int(qualified['primary'] is None), 'source-derived acceptance retains intended first-cause truth')
    raw_roles(proposed, qualified, native, mode, domain, index, data)
    return dict(record=[mode, domain, index], source=pin(canonical(proposed['source'])),
                relation=pin(canonical(proposed)), native=proposed['native'], authority=authority)


def origin_relation(data, mode, row, ctx):
    """Select source origin families independently of producer traversal."""
    value, source = row['meaning'], row['source_contract']
    helper = source['context']['helper']
    causes = cause_mode(data, mode)
    if helper is not None:
        model = ctx['source_helpers'][helper]
        failed_api = [index for index in model['api_members'] if causes['domains']['api']['records'][index]['primary'] is not None]
        failed_parse = [index for index in model['parse_members'] if causes['domains']['parses']['records'][index]['primary'] is not None]
        need(bool(failed_api) != bool(failed_parse), 'source helper has exactly one intended failing operation family')
        domain, index = ('api', min(failed_api)) if failed_api else ('parses', min(failed_parse))
        cause = causes['domains'][domain]['records'][index]
        first_source = cause['source'] if domain == 'api' else dict(context=ctx['parsers'][index], primary=cause['primary'])
        need(value['first_record'] == [mode, domain, index] and same(value['first_source'], first_source)
             and same(value['source_helper'], model) and value['primary'] == cause['primary'],
             'whole independently selected source helper first failure and consumer meaning')
        return dict(kind='source-helper-first-failure', helper=helper, first_record=[mode, domain, index],
                    first_source=first_source, cause=pin(canonical(cause)), primary=cause['primary'], source_helper=model)
    origin = value['origin']
    kind = origin['kind']
    if kind == 'whole-authored-type-width':
        name = origin['name']
        need(name in data['authored']['types'] and same(origin['source_type'], data['authored']['types'][name]),
             'whole independently admitted authored type and width source origin')
        return dict(kind=kind, model=origin, name=name, authored_type=pin(canonical(data['authored']['types'][name])))
    if kind == 'synthetic-authored-first-line-and-opaque-original-trace':
        trace = data[mode]['consumers'][3]['actual']
        need(type(trace) is str and origin['whole_native_trace'] == pin(trace.encode())
             and trace.startswith(origin['message'] + '\n'), 'complete own opaque synthetic trace and authored first line')
        return dict(kind=kind, model=origin, opaque_trace=trace, source_scope=pin(canonical(source['source_scope'])))
    if kind == 'whole-authored-actor-detached-copy':
        actor, witness_index = origin['actor'], origin['qualified_test_copy']['index']
        need(type(actor) is int and actor == 0 and same(origin['source_actor'], data['actors']['actors']['local'])
             and ctx['parsers'][actor]['source_input'] == pin(data['actors']['sources']['local'].encode()),
             'whole authored actor and own parser source input origin')
        witnesses = [item for item in data['copy_inputs']['rows'] if item['index'] == witness_index]
        proofs = [item for item in data['copy_proofs']['proofs']
                  if item['mode'] == mode and item['kind'] == 'returned' and item['original_index'] == witness_index]
        need(type(witness_index) is int and 0 <= witness_index < len(data[mode]['copies'])
             and len(witnesses) == len(proofs) == 1, 'unique complete own actor-copy witness and provider allocation')
        witness, proof = witnesses[0], proofs[0]
        provider = 'storable' if mode == 'storable' else 'ordinary'
        need(origin['qualified_test_copy']['witness'] == pin(canonical(witness))
             and origin['qualified_test_copy']['provider'] == proof['provider'] == provider
             and same(witness['native']['before'], data[mode]['copies'][witness_index]['before']),
             'whole qualified actor-copy input primitive kinds and dated provider witness')
        return dict(kind=kind, model=origin, actor=actor, parser_record=[mode, 'parses', actor],
            copy_record=[mode, 'copies', witness_index], source_actor=pin(canonical(data['actors']['actors']['local'])),
            copy_input=pin(canonical(witness)), provider_proof=pin(canonical(proof)))
    need(kind in ('readonly-authored-json', 'qualified-own-source-api'), 'complete source-derived consumer origin family')
    api = origin['api']
    need(type(api) is int and 0 <= api < len(data[mode]['api']), 'own source-derived consumer API origin allocation')
    product = data['products']['apis'][api]
    need(type(product['source_index']) is int and product['source_index'] == api
         and origin['whole_source_product'] == pin(canonical(product)), 'whole own consumer source API product association')
    return dict(kind=kind, model=origin, record=[mode, 'api', api],
        cause=pin(canonical(causes['domains']['api']['records'][api])), source_product=pin(canonical(product)))


def check(candidate):
    data = inputs()
    wanted = header(data)
    need(type(candidate) is dict and set(candidate) == set(wanted) | {'modes'}
         and type(candidate['schema_version']) is int, 'closed typed complete association schema')
    need(same({key: candidate[key] for key in wanted}, wanted), 'whole original source contract and native/private boundary custody')
    need(type(candidate['modes']) is list and len(candidate['modes']) == len(MODES)
         and all(type(mode) is dict and set(mode) == {'mode', 'operations', 'helpers', 'parsers', 'consumers'} for mode in candidate['modes'])
         and [mode['mode'] for mode in candidate['modes']] == list(MODES), 'complete ordered original association modes')
    proposed_modes = {mode['mode']: mode for mode in candidate['modes']}
    consumed, bindings = set(), []
    for ctx in data['contexts']['proofs']:
        mode = ctx['mode']
        proposed, causes, native = proposed_modes[mode], cause_mode(data, mode), data[mode]
        need(legacy(native['helpers']) == ctx['raw_helpers'] and legacy(native['consumers']) == ctx['raw_consumers']
             and legacy(native['parses']) == ctx['raw_parsers'], 'complete own original source-context native populations')
        need(type(proposed['operations']) is dict and set(proposed['operations']) == set(DOMAINS)
             and all(type(proposed['operations'][domain]) is list
                     and len(proposed['operations'][domain]) == len(records(native, domain)) for domain in DOMAINS),
             'complete original operation association populations')
        helper_maps = {domain: memberships(ctx, key, len(records(native, domain)))
                       for domain, key in (('api', 'api_members'), ('copies', 'copy_members'), ('parses', 'parse_members'))}
        api_parsers = parser_memberships(ctx, len(native['api']))
        need(type(proposed['helpers']) is list and len(proposed['helpers']) == len(ctx['source_helpers']),
             'complete source helper associations')
        for index, source in enumerate(ctx['source_helpers']):
            helper = proposed['helpers'][index]
            cause = causes['helpers'][index]
            need(type(helper) is dict and set(helper) == {'index', 'source', 'cause', 'first_record', 'primary', 'operations', 'consumers'}
                 and type(helper['index']) is int and helper['index'] == index and same(helper['source'], source)
                 and same(cause['source'], source) and same(helper['cause'], pin(canonical(cause))),
                 'whole own source helper label pattern caller and cause association')
            expected = {domain: [[mode, domain, member] for member in source[key]]
                        for domain, key in (('api', 'api_members'), ('copies', 'copy_members'), ('parses', 'parse_members'))}
            need(same(helper['operations'], expected)
                 and same(helper['consumers'], [[mode, 'consumers', member] for member in source['consumer_members']]),
                 'whole ordered source helper API copy parser and consumer memberships')
            failed = [(domain, member) for domain in ('api', 'parses') for _, _, member in expected[domain]
                      if causes['domains'][domain]['records'][member]['primary'] is not None]
            need(failed and len({domain for domain, _ in failed}) == 1, 'one own source helper failing operation family')
            domain, member = min(failed, key=lambda item: item[1])
            need(same(helper['first_record'], [mode, domain, member])
                 and same(helper['primary'], causes['domains'][domain]['records'][member]['primary']),
                 'independently selected own source helper first failed operation')
            consumed.add((mode, 'helper', index))
        need(type(proposed['parsers']) is list and len(proposed['parsers']) == len(ctx['parsers']),
             'complete original parser source associations')
        for index, source in enumerate(ctx['parsers']):
            parser = proposed['parsers'][index]
            need(type(parser) is dict and set(parser) == {'index', 'source', 'operation', 'api_operations'}
                 and type(parser['index']) is int and parser['index'] == index and same(parser['source'], source)
                 and same(parser['operation'], pin(canonical(proposed['operations']['parses'][index])))
                 and same(parser['api_operations'], [[mode, 'api', member] for member in source['api_members']]),
                 'whole own parser source text filename caller and complete API span association')
            consumed.add((mode, 'parser', index))
        for domain in ('parses', 'api', 'copies', 'test_run'):
            for index, original in enumerate(records(native, domain)):
                helper = helper_maps.get(domain, {}).get(index)
                parser = index if domain == 'parses' else api_parsers.get(index) if domain == 'api' else original.get('parse')
                link = operation_link(proposed['operations'][domain][index], causes['domains'][domain]['records'][index],
                                      original, ctx, helper, parser, mode, domain, index, data)
                key = mode, domain, index
                need(key not in consumed, 'unique original operation association consumption')
                consumed.add(key)
                bindings.append(link)
        need(type(proposed['consumers']) is list and len(proposed['consumers']) == len(ctx['source_consumers']),
             'complete source-derived consumer association population')
        consumers = consumer_mode(data, mode)['consumers']
        consumer_helpers = memberships(ctx, 'consumer_members', len(consumers))
        for index, source in enumerate(ctx['source_consumers']):
            link, qualified = proposed['consumers'][index], consumers[index]
            value, original = qualified['meaning'], native['consumers'][index]
            need(type(link) is dict and set(link) == {'index', 'source_context', 'source_contract', 'native', 'meaning',
                 'role', 'operand', 'outcome', 'truth_authority', 'origin'} and type(link['index']) is int and link['index'] == index,
                 'closed typed ordered source consumer association')
            need(source['helper'] == consumer_helpers.get(index) and same(link['source_context'], source)
                 and same(qualified['source_contract']['context'], source)
                 and same(value['source_assertion'], qualified['source_contract'])
                 and same(link['source_contract'], pin(canonical(qualified['source_contract']))),
                 'whole own consumer source assertion helper and caller context')
            need(same(link['native'], pin(canonical(original))) and same(qualified['native'], original)
                 and same(link['meaning'], pin(canonical(value))), 'whole own consumer native body and qualified source meaning')
            role = 'remaining' if source['helper'] is None else 'helper'
            need(link['role'] == qualified['role'] == role and link['truth_authority'] == 'admitted source-derived typed comparison',
                 'source-derived consumer role and truth authority')
            need(type(link['outcome']) is int and link['outcome'] in (0, 1) and link['outcome'] == value['outcome']
                 and same(link['operand'], value['operand'])
                 and same({key: original[key] for key in value['operand']}, value['operand']),
                 'complete independently admitted typed consumer operand and comparison truth')
            need(same(link['origin'], origin_relation(data, mode, qualified, ctx)),
                 'whole own source consumer API type actor copy synthetic or helper-cause origin association')
            consumed.add((mode, 'consumer', index))
            bindings.append(dict(record=[mode, 'consumer', index], relation=pin(canonical(link)), source=link['source_contract'],
                                 native=link['native'], operand=pin(canonical(link['operand'])), outcome=link['outcome']))
    expected = {(mode, domain, index) for mode in MODES for domain in DOMAINS
                for index in range(len(records(data[mode], domain)))}
    expected |= {(mode, role, index) for mode in MODES for role, count in
                 (('helper', len(context_mode(data, mode)['source_helpers'])),
                  ('parser', len(context_mode(data, mode)['parsers'])),
                  ('consumer', len(context_mode(data, mode)['source_consumers']))) for index in range(count)}
    need(consumed == expected, 'every complete original association consumed exactly once')
    return dict(owner=PLAN['owner'], revision=PLAN['revision'], candidate=pin(canonical(candidate)),
                inputs=data['identities'], contracts=wanted['contracts'], original_conditions=wanted['original_conditions'],
                bindings=bindings, consumed=[list(key) for key in sorted(consumed)], condition=PLAN['condition'])

def qualify(candidate, prefix, current=False):

    declarations = controls.declarations(candidate)
    need(len(rows) == len(declarations), 'complete native separating control population')
    for row, declaration in zip(rows, declarations):
        wanted = copy.deepcopy(candidate)
        controls.mutate(wanted, declaration)
        need((declaration['cause'] is None) == same(wanted, candidate), 'genuine separating complete candidate')
        name = prefix + 'control-' + declaration['label'] + '.json.gz'
        need(same(wanted, load_product(name)), 'whole intended native separating candidate')
        actual = json.loads((BASE / (prefix + 'control-' + declaration['label'] + '-actual.json')).read_bytes())
        need(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == declaration['status']
             and type(actual['expected_status']) is int and actual['expected_status'] == declaration['status']
             and actual['programmes'] == actual['programmes_after']
             and same(actual['candidate_inputs'], {str(BASE / name): pin((BASE / name).read_bytes())})
             and same(actual['candidate_inputs'], actual['candidate_inputs_after']),
             'actual intended native control status and complete source/input conservation')
        need((declaration['cause'] is None and actual['stdout'] == reader.SUCCESS and actual['stderr'].count('\n') == 1)
             or (declaration['cause'] is not None and actual['stdout'] == ''
                 and actual['stderr'].endswith('ValueError: ' + declaration['cause'] + '\n')),
             'intended actual native first control refusal')
        command = ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'reader.py'), '--candidate', name]
        need(actual['command'] == ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *command]
             and same(row, dict(declaration=declaration, candidate=name, identity=pin(canonical(wanted)),
                 native=pin(canonical(actual)), command=command)), 'whole native control source candidate and receipt association')
        if current:
            for name, value in actual['programmes'].items():
                body = value['body'].encode() if 'body' in value else bytes.fromhex(value['body_hex'])
                need(Path(name).read_bytes() == body, 'whole current control instrument and input epoch')
    return rows


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

        wanted = copy.deepcopy(candidate)

        name = prefix + 'control-' + declaration['label'] + '.json.gz'
        save_product(name, wanted)
        label = prefix + 'control-' + declaration['label']
        command = ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'reader.py'), '--candidate', name]

             and result.stdout == label + ' actual native status ' + str(declaration['status']) + '\n',
             'native control capture must reach intended actual declared status')
        actual = json.loads((BASE / (label + '-actual.json')).read_bytes())
        need((declaration['cause'] is None and actual['stdout'] == reader.SUCCESS and actual['stderr'].count('\n') == 1)
             or (declaration['cause'] is not None and actual['stdout'] == ''
                 and actual['stderr'].endswith('ValueError: ' + declaration['cause'] + '\n')),
             'complete intended first native separating cause: ' + declaration['label'])
        rows.append(dict(declaration=declaration, candidate=name, identity=pin(canonical(wanted)),
                         native=pin(canonical(actual)), command=command))

    for label in ('seal', 'default', 'staged-doctrines') for suffix in ('-started.json', '-actual.json')}


def read(name):
    return json.loads((BASE / name).read_bytes())


def bodies(row):
    for name, entry in row.items():
        raw = entry['body'].encode() if 'body' in entry else bytes.fromhex(entry['body_hex'])
        need(pin(raw) == entry['identity'], 'whole native programme/input body identity')
        yield name, raw


def gate(label, command, current=False, development=False, status=0):
    actual, started = read(label + '-actual.json'), read(label + '-started.json')
    extra = {'candidate_inputs'} if 'candidate_inputs' in started else set()
    need(set(started) == {'command', 'programmes', 'expected_status', 'stdout_path', 'stderr_path', 'condition'} | extra
         and set(actual) == set(started) | {'status', 'stdout', 'stderr', 'programmes_after'}
             | ({'candidate_inputs_after'} if extra else set())
         and all(same(actual[key], value) for key, value in started.items()), 'closed complete native gate')
    need(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == status
         and type(actual['expected_status']) is int and actual['expected_status'] == status
         and actual['command'] == ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *command]
         and same(actual['programmes'], actual['programmes_after']), 'typed native declared/observed outcome and conserved source epoch')
    if extra:
        need(same(actual['candidate_inputs'], actual['candidate_inputs_after']), 'whole native candidate input conservation')
        for name, identity in actual['candidate_inputs'].items():
            path = Path(name)
            need(path.parent == BASE and path.suffix == '.gz' and not path.is_symlink()
                 and pin(path.read_bytes()) == identity, 'whole saved native candidate body')
    own = {name: entry for name, entry in actual['programmes'].items() if Path(name).parent == BASE and Path(name).suffix == '.py'}
    if development:
        epoch = read('development-epochs.json')['epochs'][label]
        need(same(own, epoch['programmes']) and pin((BASE / (label + '-actual.json')).read_bytes()) == epoch['actual'],
             'complete dated development source/native epoch')
    else:
        need(same(own, read('formal-programmes.json')['programmes']), 'whole frozen formal programme membership and bodies')
    for name, raw in bodies(actual['programmes']):
        if current and not development:
            need(Path(name).read_bytes() == raw, 'whole current native programme/input body')
    stream = Path('.artifacts') / BASE.name / 'checks' / label
    need(actual['stdout_path'] == str(stream / 'stdout.txt') and actual['stderr_path'] == str(stream / 'stderr.txt')
         and re.match(r'ram-guard: PID [0-9]+; host [0-9]+\.[0-9]+%; host cutoff 88%; descendant RSS cutoff 4096 MiB; poll 2s\n', actual['stderr'])
         and 'ram-guard: terminating PID tree' not in actual['stderr'], 'unchanged guard and repository-local full terminal routes')
    return pin(canonical(actual))


def failures():
    initial = read('development-initial-programmes.json')
    programmes = initial['programmes']
    need(len(programmes) == 8, 'complete first development source population')
    for name, raw in bodies(programmes):
        if Path(name).name not in ('reader.py', 'capture.py'):
            need(Path(name).read_bytes() == raw, 'every unaffected first programme retains')
    repaired = read('typed-equality-repair.json')
    before, after = repaired['before'], repaired['after']
    need(same(before, programmes[str(BASE / 'reader.py')]), 'whole first failing reader source')
    body = before['body']
    for old, new in repaired['replacements']:
        need(body.count(old) == 1, 'unique minimal typed comparison repair beforeimage')
        body = body.replace(old, new)
    need(body == after['body'] and pin(body.encode()) == after['identity']
         and (BASE / 'reader.py').read_bytes() == body.encode()
         and repaired['diff'] == ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(before['body'].splitlines(True), body.splitlines(True),
             fromfile='first-development/reader.py', tofile='typed-repair/reader.py')), 'whole exact canonical typed-equality repair')
    capture = programmes[str(BASE / 'capture.py')]
    for name in ('capture-typed-repair-expansion.json', 'capture-candidate-input-expansion.json'):
        expansion = read(name)
        need(same(expansion['before'], capture), 'whole successive capture source epoch')
        capture = expansion['after']
        need(pin(capture['body'].encode()) == capture['identity'], 'whole capture input custody source expansion')
    need((BASE / 'capture.py').read_bytes() == capture['body'].encode(), 'whole current final capture source')
    result = {}
    for label, cause in (
        ('development-boolean-alias', 'whole own parser source text filename caller and complete API span association'),
        ('development-float-alias', 'whole own native operation and qualified cause source custody')):
        actual = read(label + '-actual.json')
        need(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == 0
             and type(actual['expected_status']) is int and actual['expected_status'] == 1
             and actual['stdout'].startswith('FALSE-GREEN: complete reader accepted malformed ')
             and same(actual['programmes'], actual['programmes_after'])
             and all(same(actual['programmes'][name], entry) for name, entry in programmes.items()),
             'first actual0/declared1 false green remains failed with complete source epoch')
        list(bodies(actual['programmes']))
        declared = initial['failures'][label]
        need(declared['receipt_identity'] == pin((BASE / (label + '-actual.json')).read_bytes())
             and same(repaired['reproductions'][label], declared), 'whole native first failure custody')
        corrected = read(label + '-v2-actual.json')
        need(type(corrected['status']) is int and corrected['status'] == 1
             and type(corrected['expected_status']) is int and corrected['expected_status'] == 1
             and corrected['stdout'] == '' and corrected['stderr'].endswith('ValueError: ' + cause + '\n')
             and same(corrected['programmes'], corrected['programmes_after']), 'corrected real intended native first refusal')
        result[label] = dict(first=pin(canonical(actual)), corrected=pin(canonical(corrected)), cause=cause)
    return dict(reproductions=result, initial=pin(canonical(initial)), repair=pin(canonical(repaired)),
        condition='Both first actual0/declared1 results remain false greens; corrected actual1/declared1 controls qualify typed equality. Every original admitted source/meaning/native/private limit retains.')


def fresh_admission():
    """Reexecute the complete unchanged admitted reader in an isolated namespace."""
    root = PLAN['admission']
    names = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', PLAN['revision'], '--', root).decode().splitlines()
    sources = fixed(names)
    need(all(Path(name).parent == Path(root) and stat.S_ISREG(Path(name).lstat().st_mode)
             and Path(name).stat().st_dev == Path.cwd().stat().st_dev and Path(name).read_bytes() == body
             for name, body in sources.items()), 'whole ordinary same-volume fixed admission namespace')
    module_names = {Path(name).stem for name in names if name.endswith('.py')} | {'capture'}
    prior = {name: sys.modules[name] for name in module_names if name in sys.modules}
    old_path, old_argv = sys.path[:], sys.argv[:]
    entry = root + '/verify.py'
    namespace = {'__name__': '__main__', '__file__': entry}
    terminal = io.StringIO()
    try:
        for name in module_names:
            sys.modules.pop(name, None)
        sys.path.insert(0, root)
        sys.argv[:] = [entry]
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(terminal):
            exec(compile(sources[entry], entry, 'exec'), namespace)
    finally:
        sys.path[:] = old_path
        sys.argv[:] = old_argv
        for name in module_names:
            sys.modules.pop(name, None)
        sys.modules.update(prior)
    wanted = json.loads(sources[root + '/proof.json'])
    need(same(namespace['result'], wanted)
         and terminal.getvalue() == namespace['SUCCESS']
         and all(Path(name).read_bytes() == body for name, body in sources.items()),
         'fresh whole unchanged admitted source/context/cause/consumer meaning and delivery proof')
    return dict(proof=pin(canonical(wanted)), namespace={name: pin(body) for name, body in sources.items()},
                stdout=terminal.getvalue(), condition=PLAN['condition'])


def preflight():
    failures()
    data = inputs()
    candidate = model.propose(data)
    qualification = reader.check(candidate)
    for declaration in controls.declarations(candidate):
        wanted = json.loads(canonical(candidate))
        controls.mutate(wanted, declaration)
        need((declaration['cause'] is None) == same(wanted, candidate), 'genuine development-only separating mutation')
        try:
            reader.check(wanted)
        except ValueError as error:
            need(declaration['status'] == 1 and str(error) == declaration['cause'],
                 'intended development-only library refusal: ' + declaration['label'])
        else:
            need(declaration['status'] == 0, 'development-only false green: ' + declaration['label'])
    before = {name: Path(name).read_bytes() for name in publish.NAMES}
    need(all(before[name] == body for name, body in intake.overlays().items()), 'whole declared activation metadata')
    after, measured = publish.transformation(before)
    first, last = nodes(before[TASK]), nodes(after[TASK])
    need(first.keys() == last.keys(), 'complete projected task population')
    for name, block in first.items():
        need((all(field(block, key) == field(last[name], key) for key in ('Goal', 'Acceptance', 'Children'))
              and field(last[name], 'Status') == 'done') if name == PLAN['owner'] else block == last[name],
             'whole unchanged projected contracts and only owned closure')
    physical = metrics({'MEMORY.md': after['MEMORY.md']})
    for row in map(json.loads, after[REGISTRY].splitlines()):
        if row.get('surface_id') == 'active_resume':
            need(all(key == 'files' or value * 100 < row['health_targets'][key] * row['milestones']['warning_pct']
                     for key, value in physical.items()), 'all resume health axes below warning')
        elif row.get('surface_id') in ('task_evidence', 'shipped_behavior'):
            actual = measured['task_metrics' if row['surface_id'] == 'task_evidence' else 'book_after']
            need(all(row['enforcement_ceilings'][key] is None or value <= row['enforcement_ceilings'][key]
                     for key, value in actual.items()), 'all unchanged task/book physical ceilings')
    factory = public()
    prior, sources = factory['historical'](), factory['sources']()
    record = factory['current_input'](prior, sources)
    record['chapter'] = after[BOOK].decode()
    factory['check'](record, sources, prior, factory['authority'](prior))
    snapshots = {}
    for i, name in enumerate(publish.NAMES):
        snapshots[name] = {}
        for role, body in (('before', before[name]), ('after', after[name])):
            path = BASE / ('development-publication-' + role + '-' + str(i) + '.gz')
            need(not path.exists(), 'retain first development publication source')
            path.write_bytes(gzip.compress(body, mtime=0))
            snapshots[name][role] = dict(snapshot=str(path), identity=pin(body))
    save_product('development-candidate.json.gz', candidate)
    save_product('development-qualification.json.gz', qualification)
    save('development-preflight.json', dict(contracts=contracts(), snapshots=snapshots, measured=measured,
        candidate=pin(canonical(candidate)), qualification=pin(canonical(qualification)), resume=physical,
        declarations=controls.declarations(candidate), failures=failures()))
    need(all(Path(name).read_bytes() == body for name, body in before.items()), 'whole development targets remain readonly')
    print('PASS development-only complete association, intended library controls and publication/capacity preflight; formal native controls remain required.')


def core(current=False):
    frozen = read('formal-programmes.json')
    need(frozen['owner'] == PLAN['owner'] and frozen['phase'] == 'formal'
         and set(frozen['programmes']) == {str(path) for path in BASE.glob('*.py')}, 'complete frozen formal source population')
    need(all(Path(name).read_bytes() == raw for name, raw in bodies(frozen['programmes'])), 'whole unchanged final formal programmes')
    normal = read('admission-normal-commit.json')
    commit = re.search(r'^\[[^\]]+ ([0-9a-f]{7,40})\] ', normal['stdout'])
    need(type(normal['status']) is int and normal['status'] == 0
         and normal['command'] == ['git', '--no-pager', 'commit', '-F', 'git_message_brief.txt']
         and '[doctrine] all doctrine checks passed' in normal['stdout'] + normal['stderr']
         and commit is not None and git('rev-parse', commit[1]).decode().strip() == PLAN['revision'],
         'complete prior admission normal commit and hooks')
    commands = {
        'source-before': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'intake.py'), '--before'],
        'replay-admission': ['python3', '-B', PLAN['admission'] + '/verify.py'],
        'proposal': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'produce.py')],
        'independent': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'reader.py'), '--save'],
        'native-controls': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'run_controls.py')],
        'current-before': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'current_snapshot.py'), 'before'],
        'source-after': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'intake.py'), '--after'],
        'root-history': ['git', 'log', '-1', '-S', 'Join complete original source context, cause, coordinate and consumer semantics.', '--format=%H %s', '--', 'docs/tasks/']}
    gates = {label: gate(label, command, current) for label, command in commands.items()}
    for label, command in {
        'development-source': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'intake.py'), '--development'],
        'development-preflight': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'verify.py'), '--preflight'],
        'development-whitespace': ['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check']}.items():
        gates[label] = gate(label, command, current, True)
    roles = intake.derive()
    need(same(roles, read('source-roles.json')) and same(read('source-before.json'), read('source-after.json')),
         'whole source roles and formal native epoch conserve')
    admission = fresh_admission()
    need(read('replay-admission-actual.json')['stdout'] == admission['stdout'], 'whole complete native saved admission replay')
    candidate = load_product('candidate.json.gz')
    data = inputs()
    need(same(candidate, model.propose(data)), 'complete mode-first proposal source correspondence')
    qualification = reader.check(candidate)
    need(same(qualification, read('qualification.json')), 'complete independent source-first association qualification')
    separating = run_controls.qualify(candidate, '', current)
    for row in separating:
        declaration = row['declaration']
        gates['control-' + declaration['label']] = gate('control-' + declaration['label'], row['command'], current,
                                                       status=declaration['status'])
    developed = read('development-preflight.json')
    need(same(candidate, load_product('development-candidate.json.gz'))
         and same(qualification, load_product('development-qualification.json.gz'))
         and same(developed['declarations'], controls.declarations(candidate))
         and same(developed['contracts'], contracts()) and same(developed['failures'], failures()),
         'whole development/formal source/candidate/control/failure correspondence')
    before = {name: gzip.decompress(Path(entry['before']['snapshot']).read_bytes()) for name, entry in developed['snapshots'].items()}
    after, measured = publish.transformation(before)
    need(same(measured, developed['measured']) and all(
         gzip.decompress(Path(developed['snapshots'][name]['after']['snapshot']).read_bytes()) == body for name, body in after.items()),
         'whole projected publication reconstruction')
    factory = public()
    prior, sources = factory['historical'](), canonical_sources()
    need(same(load_product('canonical-before.json.gz'), {name: body.decode() for name, body in sources.items()}),
         'all original canonical facts/questions/probes conserve')
    factory['check'](load_product('current-before.json.gz'), sources, prior, factory['authority'](prior))
    need(re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40} .+\n', read('root-history-actual.json')['stdout']), 'whole original join obligation history')
    return dict(owner=PLAN['owner'], revision=PLAN['revision'], contracts=contracts(), admission=admission,
        qualification=qualification, controls=separating, source=pin(canonical(roles)), source_epoch=read('source-before.json'),
        development=pin(canonical(developed)), failures=failures(), normal_commit=pin(canonical(normal)), gates=gates,
        condition=PLAN['condition'], legs=dict(
            rederive='Whole source-first operation/helper/parser/consumer relations, unchanged original contracts and fresh complete saved admitted source/context/cause/consumer meanings, source/current/query/capacity.',
            falsify='Genuine complete changed associations reach intended actual native first refusals, including both corrected primitive-kind aliases. Both first actual0/declared1 false greens remain failed. Qualified source-derived primary causes and typed consumer truths are shared premises, never native flags.',
            durability='Full unchanged original sources/native/model/products and own programme/input/command/status/stream/candidate/control/failure/repair/publication epochs, immutable saved reconstruction and normal hooks. Original native/private uncertainty, dated executions and wider owners retain.'))


def delivery(current=False):
    publication = publish.qualify(current)
    before, after = load_product('canonical-before.json.gz'), load_product('canonical-after.json.gz')
    need(same(before, after), 'all canonical facts/questions/probes retain')
    factory = public()
    prior = factory['historical']()
    record = load_product('current-after.json.gz')
    factory['check'](record, {name: body.encode() for name, body in after.items()}, prior, factory['authority'](prior))
    need(record['chapter'].encode() == gzip.decompress(Path(publication['snapshots'][BOOK]['after']['snapshot']).read_bytes()),
         'whole current published chapter')
    source = read('source-published.json')
    need(same(source, dict(read('source-before.json'), overlays={name: pin(body) for name, body in intake.overlays(True).items()})),
         'whole source conservation with only five intended publication overlays')
    if current:
        need(factory['sources']() == {name: body.encode() for name, body in after.items()}
             and same(intake.live(intake.derive(), True), source), 'complete actual current source/canonical epoch')
    native = book_native.qualify(gzip.decompress((BASE / 'native-chapter.html.gz').read_bytes()).decode())
    need(same(native, read('book-native.json')), 'whole actual native chapter qualification')
    commands = dict(publish.COMMANDS, core=['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'verify.py'), '--core', '--current'],
        publication=['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'publish.py')],
        **{'current-after': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'current_snapshot.py'), 'after'],
           'book-source': ['python3', '-B', 'scripts/book_source_references.py', '--write'],
           'source-published': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'intake.py'), '--published'],
           'book-native': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'book_native.py')],
           'whitespace': ['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check']})
    gates = {label: gate(label, command, current) for label, command in commands.items()}
    need('All tests successful' in read('focused-actual.json')['stdout'], 'actual focused regression success')
    return dict(publication=publication, current=pin(canonical(record)), source=source, native=native, gates=gates)


def catalogue():
    result = {}
    for path in sorted(BASE.iterdir()):
        info = path.lstat()
        need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_dev == Path.cwd().stat().st_dev,
             'whole flat ordinary same-volume association archive')
        if path.name not in EXCLUDED:
            result[path.name] = dict(**pin(path.read_bytes()), executable=bool(info.st_mode & 0o111))
    return result
